popup.heading: Photos from Immich

inspect.label: Inspect Immich
inspect.sub: Reads when and where your photos were taken and drafts the route and the nights. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

album.label: Create album in Immich
album.sub: Makes an album named like the journey and adds its photos.
album.blockedShared: Albums can only be created on your own Immich connection, not on a shared one.
album.blockedScopes: Your API key cannot create albums. It needs album.read, album.create and albumAsset.create.

popup.checkFailed: Immich could not be checked just now. Try the switch again in a moment.

unpaired.title: Immich is not connected yet
unpaired.description: Connect your Immich library in Settings. This form stays open here while you do.
unpaired.banner: Add the Immich address and an API key under Settings › Services.
unpaired.link: Open Immich settings in a new tab

popup.scopesMissing: Your Immich API key lacks permissions the scan needs:
popup.unverified: TravStats could not verify your key's permissions. The scan will find out.
popup.roadtripsOff: Trips are off, so the draft has no kilometres or nights. If your instance offers them, turn them on under Settings › Modules.
popup.needDates: Set a start and an end date to scan photos.
popup.tooLong: Photos can be scanned for up to 62 days at a time. Shorten the dates.

launch.needDates: Set a start and an end date before scanning photos.
launch.notConfigured: Immich is not connected. Add its address and an API key in Settings.
launch.failed: The scan could not be started. Nothing was saved.

chooser.title: Build it from your photos
chooser.description: Scans the photos in your Immich library for the journey's dates and drafts the route, the nights and an album. You review everything before anything is saved.

commit.tripChanged: This journey changed since the scan. Scan again — your edits are kept.
commit.routeScopeConflict: These stops also belong to another trip of the journey, so nothing was saved. Sync that trip, or fix the dates first.
commit.draftExpired: This draft has expired. Scan again; your edits are kept.
commit.draftMismatch: The draft no longer matches what was sent. Reload the page and try again.
commit.failed: The journey could not be created and nothing was saved. Try again.
commit.inProgress: A save is already running for this draft.
commit.nightPlanInvalid: The nights do not add up. Check the night fields and try again.
commit.roadtripsHidden: Trips are switched off. Save the areas as timeline stops, or turn trips on in Settings.
commit.stationsInvalid: A trip needs at least two valid stops. Check the areas and try again.
commit.tooManyAreas: These dates hold more areas than one journey can take. Scan a shorter window, then try again.
commit.tooManyFlights: More flights are ticked than one save can assign. Untick some, then try again.
commit.tooManyJourneys: More photo suggestions are ticked than one save can mark. Untick some, then try again.
commit.windowChanged: The dates changed since the scan. Scan again.

edit.resyncHint: Scans the journey's saved dates again and updates it in place.
edit.resyncTripHint: Scans this trip's saved dates again and updates that trip in place. The journey's other trips stay as they are.
edit.deleteJourneyHint: The journey itself goes. Its trips are detached and kept, and the Immich album is not touched.
edit.deleteTripHint: This trip goes with its stations, legs and recordings. Linked accommodation and its day tours are kept.
